confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several 2025–2026 Bruges and Belgium price sources that disagree somewhat, so they are bounded rather than precise. Cocktail and wine are inferred from a few venue examples and from the local beer price. Both hotel anchors and both hostel anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, with no live listings checked. EUR figures were converted to USD at an assumed rate of about 1.15 USD per EUR, which I did not source. The FX observation came from a search summary that cites the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the page, and the 16 Oct value may not yet have been published at the 4 pm AEST release time.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are anchored to Bruges and Belgian tourist-centre price reports, with the 2026 cost-of-living listing weighted most heavily. Cocktail and wine use the local beer relationship because direct data was weak. Accommodation is a general-knowledge estimate for a historic Belgian tourist city in summer peak season, roughly in line with comparable Flemish and Dutch heritage cities.
